messages:
Oliver K: Morning — async standup.
What I did: finished eval harness for llama3-small-q variant, ran 150 promptsets across en/es/pt.
Blockers: seeing ~4% regression on Spanish system prompts after tokenizer change — outputs drop BLEU-like metric from 0.82 -> 0.73 for some cases. attached sample below.
Today: triage tokenization, open PR to normalize non-breaking space handling, coordinate with QA for repro.

Chen L: which eval job did you run? can you paste job id + small reproducer?

Oliver K: job_id: 20260316_oliver_042, run_id: 6689
Reproducer:
```
python ./run_eval.py --model llama3-small-q --prompts prompts/spanish_sys.json --seed 42 --batch 32
```
Sample failing input:
"¿Cómo estás?␠¿Lista?"
Expected tokenization: ['¿', 'Cómo', ...] got extra NBSP in middle.

Maria G: I'll take tokenizer triage. taking ownership for now. @Sam R can you help with a quick KV-cold-start repro? Might be related to longctx truncation.

Sam R: ack. will run local repro on my linux-gpu node. saw similar spike in spanish-longctx job last night (job 20260315_maria_121). I'll compare tokenized outputs and KV cache length. ping @Oliver K for sample logs.

Oliver K: attaching short log excerpt:
```
MODEL OUTPUT: "Hola amigo"    # NBSP in output
TOKEN IDS: [101, 2345, 16000, ...]  # 16000 is NBSP token
EVAL METRIC: 0.73
```

deploy-bot: auto-note: scheduled warmup task queued for llama3-small-q on dedicated-prod, warmup id wmp-993, ETA 15m.

Maria G: created PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2156 — normalizes NBSPs in tokenizer preproc. requesting review from @Chen L @Oliver K. leaving comments with sample diffs.

Chen L: quick code-review: minor nit in tokenizer.normalize() but overall looks good. please add a unit test for multi-byte whitespace.

Sam R: repro done locally, NVidia node gtx-80. KV warmup didn't affect NBSP occurrence; looks strictly tokenizer input normalization. :thumbsup:

Oliver K: thanks team. blocker -> owned by Maria. I'll rerun full eval after PR merges and report results in this thread.

Maria G: merging in ~30m, will trigger CI and post green results.

Oliver K: that should be fine — today I'll also start a short Canary with 5% traffic on staging if metrics look good. will post follow-up.

Chen L: FYI saved failing examples to S3: s3://redwood-evals/oliver/20260316/spanish-nbsp-samples.tar.gz

Sam R: noted. will add a quick check in the eval harness to fail early if NBSP tokens occur in tokenized ids.

Oliver K: thanks all. end."
